name: obs-static-site
description: Static site generator for Obsidian vault content

scripts.serve: node -e "require('http').createServer((req,res)=>{const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');let file=req.url=='/'?'/index.html':req.url;fs.readFile('./dist'+file,(err,data)=>{if(err){res.writeHead(404);res.end('Not found');return;}const ext=path.extname(file);const types={'html':'text/html','css':'text/css','js':'application/javascript','json':'application/json'};res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':types[ext.slice(1)]||'text/plain'});res.end(data);})}).listen(8080,()=>console.log('Server running at http://localhost:8080'))"
scripts.watch: nodemon --watch ../obs-site --watch templates --watch build.js --watch nav.json -e md,css,js,json --exec 'node build.js && npm run serve'
